Shipping, Returns & Pricing Policies

SHIPPING & DELIVERY

Orders are shipped only on business days: Monday - Friday, excluding US holidays.We aim to ship all orders within 3-5 business days. 

  • Free USA Shipping on all orders of $150 or more.
  • International delivery is available to 150+ countries and will calculate at checkout.


Check out our Shipping Information for more details.

RETURNS & EXCHANGES

  • Items can be returned or exchanged within 60 days from the date of purchase and must be in new, unworn, unwashed condition with original tags attached.

  • Exclusions: Hats, gaiters, underwear, swimwear without hygienic liners, pet apparel, pet accessories, sunglasses without all original packaging & accessories, leather products without the black bag, and all items marked FINAL SALE are not eligible for return or exchange.


We reserve the right to refuse any return or exchange that we deem ineligible.

Check out our Return Policy for more details.

PRICING & AVAILABILITY

Prices for Dixxon products are subject to change at any time, without notice.

We reserve the right to modify or discontinue any product, service, or promotion—temporarily or permanently—at any time. In the event of a price change, the price listed at the time an order is placed is the price that is applied to that purchase, unless stated otherwise.

Dixxon is not required nor liable for reporting of any modifications, price changes, suspensions, or discontinuations of products or services to an customers or third-parties.

Check out our Terms of Service for more details.
